package simplify_test

import (
    "strings"
    "strconv"
    "testing"
    "fmt"
)

func simplify(x string, n string) bool {
    partsX := strings.Split(x, "/")
    partsN := strings.Split(n, "/")

    xNum, _ := strconv.Atoi(partsX[0])
    xDen, _ := strconv.Atoi(partsX[1])
    nNum, _ := strconv.Atoi(partsN[0])
    nDen, _ := strconv.Atoi(partsN[1])

    productNum := xNum * nNum
    productDen := xDen * nDen

    return productNum % productDen == 0
}
